runs.text:
🌙 LUNAs Tunes

Dark Cinematic Rock / Mythic Pop / Emotional Storytelling

Songs about shadow, resilience, mythology, dark fairytales and becoming whole.

No trends.
No noise.
Just stories carried through music.

LUNAs Tunes is a one-person creative project combining original songwriting, cinematic storytelling and modern creative tools to build emotional worlds through music and visuals.

Luna walks through myths, legends and forgotten tales.
She does not become gods or monsters.
She listens to them.
She remembers them.

Each song is another step through ancient worlds, haunted forests and the hidden parts of ourselves.

Themes:
mythology • dark fairytales • emotional transformation • memory • quiet defiance

If you are here,
you probably already feel it 🌒
